subject: Clarification of Shiny Server Pro 20 concurrent users limitation

messages.author: 8acbcba9d724d938
messages.subject: Clarification of Shiny Server Pro 20 concurrent users limitation
parts:
Hello,


I have a question about Shiny Server Pro limit of „20 Concurrent Users“. Namely, does this mean that if I run my own Shiny server then at most at given time 20 different users can have access to the apps being hosted in the server? I.e. if I have 20 users actively using the different apps being hosted in server then 21th user’s connection attempt will be rejected?

 

 

With Best Regards,
Mait Metelitsa

messages.author: f66be21d595ccb8b
messages.subject: Re: Clarification of Shiny Server Pro 20 concurrent users limitation
parts:
In short, yes. However, a user a user-browser, so the same user can concurrently connect to multiple apps using the same browser and it will all count as a single user. If they concurrently connect with multiple devices, each will count separately. In either case, each connection applies to the 200 connection limit.

Chris
